name: vivreal-site-migrator
description: The Vivreal_Site_Migrator agent fleet, migrated out of that repo's local .claude directory (master-branch, no CI; a push here deploys nothing). Turns a live site or a design exemplar into a Vivreal site/template through a staged pipeline: ingest classifies a raw crawl into a ContentInventory; collections and integrations model its collection groups and integration signals; site assembles the page/format/binding structure last; kit-designer scouts a design exemplar and writes the identity-kit brief; component-builder builds or matches the aesthetic; page-confirm and studio-confirm prove render-level and Studio-editability fidelity; studio-registrar closes any portal registration gap a kit or migration opens; migration-estimator costs a migration before anyone commits to it; cutover is the USER-GATED agent that loads an approved blueprint into production. Plus the /migrate and /template commands. Distinct from vivreal-experts:sites-stack (read-only consultant on the deployed renderer/Templates stack) and vivreal-product:template-critic (judges the finished result against its exemplar).
